title: CARLA-native glare to real ORION input interface staging record
research_role: Provide an auditable clean-versus-native-glare observation intervention for later engineering closed-loop screens. This is an interface record, not a robustness or safety result.

implementation.pairing_rule: clean, medium and heavy share the route's frozen low-sun weather; only CAM_FRONT lens flare and bloom differ. BEV postprocess, flare and bloom are disabled in all three paired profiles.
implementation.sensor_spawn_hook: Patch Leaderboard AgentWrapper._preprocess_sensor_spec before RGB sensor construction.
implementation.runtime_readback: At the first ORION run_step, read the actual CARLA CAM_FRONT/BEV actor attributes and world weather; active-profile absence or mismatch fails closed.
implementation.model_input_capture: The saved diagnostic tensor must be the exact post-corruption uint8 BGR CAM_FRONT model tensor with shape 640x640x3; no resize or fallback is allowed.

platform_staging.static_full_chain_test: expected deferred failure because remote team_code/orion_b2d_agent.py and run_closedloop_uq_pilot.sh were deliberately not overwritten during active hash-bound Stage2-L job 1112878

remaining: After job 1112878 is terminal, sync the exact hashed agent and runner and require the full platform suite to pass.
Verify CARLA 0.9.15 actor readback of exposure, lens-flare and bloom attributes.
Verify actual clean/medium/heavy differences in saved front view and exact 640x640 ORION input tensor.
Verify the frozen route XML low-sun weather is retained by the evaluator.

dependency_freeze.reason: The staged trainer imports the legacy ORION agent module for a path resolver. Changing that file after the hash-bound training submission would alter an indirect runtime dependency.
dependency_freeze.policy: Do not activate the remote agent or runner changes until the training job is terminal. Record activation in a new amendment rather than rewriting this staging record.

claim_boundary: This record establishes implementation intent and staged tests only. It does not show that native glare changes ORION behavior, that the adapter detects it, or that closed-loop TTC, collision, completion or traffic-rule metrics improve.
